title: The scripts under Server and Servex: what each is, who calls it, which are stale

chat.text: About a hundred scripts sit under Server and Servex with no census. A script lists each one with its header line, its callers, its last commit and whether it is a class; Haiku gives a verdict (live, hand-run tool, stale, misnamed) with evidence; you get a tick-list of the stale ones, a mover with undo that is not run, and the misnamed ones go to the todo list.
